# Mod List — Infinite Domain

*Generated by `scripts/build_mod_index.py` from `mods/*.jar` (reading each jar's `neoforge.mods.toml`/`mods.toml`), cross-referenced with `minecraftinstance.json` for display name/author. 192 jars total: 183 third-party + 9 project-built. Re-run the script whenever mods are added, removed, or updated.*

Item/block counts (where available) are from `docs/registry-inventory/namespace-summary.csv`, keyed by the mod's primary namespace — a mod can register under a different namespace than its file name suggests, and mods that add no items/blocks (pure libraries, mixin patches, API shims) show blank counts.
